6h6qzFRGzJ8rxozZ.name: Skills
6h6qzFRGzJ8rxozZ.description: Choose any two skills from the Technical, Social, or Knowledge skill groups — a bedside-manner or reading-people skill like Insight rounds out a Medic. Skip your specialization skill (Street-Doc: Streetwise, Corp-Medtech: Corporate, Ripperdoc: Cybertech); it’s granted separately. (Quick Build: Insight, Contacts.)

gyFAbObyt3VnWhix.name: Kit
gyFAbObyt3VnWhix.description: You can use and gain the benefits of a light Kit (no armor or light armor, and no heavy weapon), or a combat-medic medium Kit (Streetsweeper or Breacher) if you expect to give and take hits. Most Medics work through the bag alone. (Quick Build: Gunslinger.)

M1Fba1Zq0VIqRSve.name: Medic Specialization
M1Fba1Zq0VIqRSve.description:
Choose your specialization: Street-Doc (the back-alley generalist with the best kit economy), Corp-Medtech (the clean professional with better product and a softer crash), or Ripperdoc (the chrome surgeon with a self-revive capstone). Each grants a skill. (Quick Build: Street-Doc.)

Your specialization is your subclass, and it determines many of the features you gain as you level.

uRB3PN73ojGqu0YL.name: Signature Abilities
uRB3PN73ojGqu0YL.description: You gain all three Medic signature abilities: First Aid, Administer Dose, and Diagnose. None of them costs Reagents; spending Reagents enhances them.

before0000000000.description:
A creature who uses the Catch Breath maneuver spends a Recovery and regains [[/heal @recoveries.recoveryValue]]{Stamina} equal to their recovery value.

A creature who is dying can’t use the Catch Breath maneuver, but other creatures can help them spend Recoveries in other ways.

tier2.display: You can escape the grab, but if you do, a creature who has you grabbed can make a melee free strike against you before you are no longer grabbed.

before0000000000.description: A creature who is grabbed by another creature, an object, or an effect (see Grab below) can attempt to escape by using the following ability.

after00000000000.description: You take a bane on this maneuver if your size is smaller than the size of the creature, object, or effect that has you grabbed.

tier2.display: You can grab the target, but if you do, the target can make a melee free strike against you before they are grabbed

tier3.display: The target is grabbed by you.

before0000000000.description: A creature seeking to keep a foe close and locked down can attempt to grab a creature using the following ability

after00000000000.description: You can usually target only creatures of your size or smaller. If your Might score is 2 or higher, you can target any creature with a size equal to or less than your Might score.
You can usually target only creatures of your size or smaller. If your Might score is 2 or higher, you can target any creature with a size equal to or less than your Might score.

before0000000000.description: A creature can use the Stand Up maneuver to stand up if they are prone, ending that condition. Alternatively, they can use this maneuver to make a willing adjacent prone creature stand up.
When a creature takes the Advance move action, they move a number of squares up to their speed. They can break up this movement with their maneuver and main action however they wish.

When a creature takes the Disengage move action, they can shift [[lookup @movement.disengage]]{1} square(s). Certain class features, kits, and other rules allow a creature to shift more than 1 square when they disengage. A creature who does so can break up their shift with their maneuver and main action however they wish.

effects.name: Spotted
effects.description: Tagged for the crew. The next ability power roll an ally makes against this creature before the start of the spotter’s next turn has an edge — and spends the tag.
